description: 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부_우체국금융 예금상품정보 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. 2022년 3월 기준 우체국에서 취급하는 예금상품에 관한 정보입니다. 자료는 2022년 3월 기준 우정사업본부 우체국금융의 예금상품 현황을 정리한 CSV 파일로, 예금 상품별 가입조건, 기본이율, 고객유형, 이자지급방식 등 핵심 정보를 포함하고 있다. 가장 기본적인 상품인 ‘보통예금(상품코드 10100)... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. Its tags are 우체국 예금상품, 상품코드 및 상품명, 최소·최대 가입금액, 가입기간 조건, 기본이율. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
